newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler sees management more efficient.
newsitem.headline: Daimler sees management more efficient.

text.p: Daimler-Benz AG Chairman Juergen Schrmempp said on Wednesday that a sweeping reorganisation should result in a 40 percent increase in management efficiency by the end of 1997.
Speaking at the company's annual meeting, Schrempp said he expected the reorganisation to bring further efficiency gains resulting in "a 40 percent improvement in operations."
Earlier this year Daimler legally ended its Mercedes-Benz AG car and truck division, bringing it into a group structure.
The move was designed to speed up decision-making and streamline what many analysts believed to be an unwieldy management structure.
